mapper.select: select PROD_ID id, PROD_NAME name, PD_STATUS||ISSUING_WAY||PROD_SERIES pid from REP_PROD_INFO where status='E' and REP_PROD_TYPE in ('01','02') and PROD_SERIES is not null

select prod.PROD_ID id, prod.PROD_ID || prod.PROD_NAME name, (prod.PD_STATUS||prod.ISSUING_WAY|| prod.PROD_SERIES || to_char(case when prod.REP_PROD_TYPE = '03' then pprod.PROD_NAME else prod.PROD_NAME end)) pid from REP_PROD_INFO prod left join V_REP_PROD_INFO pprod on prod.p_prod_id = pprod.prod_id where prod.rep_prod_type='03' AND prod.status='E' AND prod.PROD_SERIES is not null union all select prod.PROD_ID id, prod.PROD_ID || prod.PROD_NAME name, (prod.PD_STATUS||prod.ISSUING_WAY|| prod.PROD_SERIES) pid from REP_PROD_INFO prod -- left join V_REP_PROD_INFO pprod -- on prod.p_prod_id = pprod.prod_id where prod.rep_prod_type='02' AND prod.status='E' AND prod.PROD_SERIES is not null

SELECT PROD_ID prodId, PROD_RE prodRe, PROD_NAME prodName, PROD_ABBR prodAbbr, 0 raiseMin, 0 raiseMax, RAISE_STRDATE raiseStrdate, RAISE_ENDDATE raiseEnddate, null raiseCcy, SET_DATE setDate, null vdate, null firstOpenDay, MDATE mdate, MDATE actMdate, null term, null windupDate, null issueMode, PROFIT_TYPE profitType, PROD_TYPE prodType, ISSUE_STATUS issueStatus, RAISE_TYPE raiseType, null riskLevel, null revealChannel FROM REP_PROD_INFO where 1=1 ${sqlVal} AND STATUS = 'E' and ISSUE_STATUS ='01' and REP_PROD_TYPE in ('02','03') AND NOT EXISTS(select 1 FROM REP_JOB_EXCLUDE_PRO pro WHERE pro.PROD_ID=REP_PROD_INFO.PROD_ID and pro.JOB_ID=#{jobId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) union all SELECT PROD_ID prodId, PROD_RE prodRe, PROD_NAME prodName, PROD_ABBR prodAbbr, 0 raiseMin, 0 raiseMax, RAISE_STRDATE raiseStrdate, RAISE_ENDDATE raiseEnddate, null raiseCcy, SET_DATE setDate, null vdate, null firstOpenDay, MDATE mdate, MDATE actMdate, null term, null windupDate, null issueMode, PROFIT_TYPE profitType, PROD_TYPE prodType, ISSUE_STATUS issueStatus, RAISE_TYPE raiseType, null riskLevel, null revealChannel FROM V_REP_PROD_INFO v where 1=1 ${sqlVal} AND STATUS = 'E' and ISSUE_STATUS ='01' and REP_PROD_TYPE in('01') AND NOT EXISTS(select 1 FROM REP_JOB_EXCLUDE_PRO pro WHERE pro.PROD_ID=v.PROD_ID and pro.JOB_ID=#{jobId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select info1.prod_id,info1.prod_name,info1.rep_prod_type,info1.p_prod_id,info2.prod_name from REP_PROD_INFO info1 left join REP_PROD_INFO info2 on info1.p_prod_id=info2.prod_id where info1.status='E' info1.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
